story.title: Story 4: Provenance and Canonical Source Visibility

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification stayed scoped to the prior gate-only blocker: I checked the formatted Story 4 client test, reran `corepack pnpm run green-verify`, and traced the new gate failure to the directly touched mixed-success provenance regression test and its execution contract.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: `tests/service/client/source-provenance-section.test.ts:54-57` now matches Biome’s expected wrapping, and `corepack pnpm run green-verify` cleared `format:check` instead of failing on the prior formatting drift.

newFindings.title: The story gate now fails in typecheck on the new mixed-success provenance regression test
newFindings.evidence: `corepack pnpm run green-verify` now gets past `format:check` and `lint`, but fails in `typecheck` at `tests/service/server/process-live-updates.test.ts:1453-1475`. The new `executeScript()` fixture returns `codeCheckpointCandidates` objects missing `displayName`, `accessMode`, and `workspaceRef`, while `apps/platform/server/services/processes/environment/provider-adapter.ts:96-107` requires those fields on every `CodeCheckpointCandidate`. Until that touched Story 4 test matches the current execution contract, the configured story gate remains red.
